== Summary ==
[[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 11 October 2009 (date from the camera's date stamp): "he'd order a damn beer of course" (evening in the hotel).

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom), album "philly and jersey worlds": [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096912668/ he'd order a damn beer of course] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2702/4096912668_8d8e362602_b.jpg). Several were posted to the forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=31192 2009 Worlds pictures] (topic 31192), e.g. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom], 12 November 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
